about: Byeongsook Seo is a top-rated attorney practicing in the Denver, Colorado area. Providing legal representation in Colorado for a variety of different issues, Byeongsook Seo was selected to Super Lawyers for 2010 - 2027.

After completing undergraduate studies, Byeongsook Seo attended law school. Byeongsook Seo was enrolled at University of Denver Sturm College of Law. He earned a juris doctor degree in 1999. Byeongsook Seo was admitted to the practice of law in 1999.

Attorneys like Byeongsook Seo are recognized by their peers for their outstanding work and commitment to the spirit of the legal profession. Their knowledge of the law, professional work ethic, and advocacy on behalf of their clients allow them to stand out among other attorneys in the field.
Byeongsook Seo represents clients with Business Litigation issues. Additional legal issues represented include Intellectual Property Litigation.
